source_rows.source: OpenAI - Running Codex safely at OpenAI
source_rows.stable_takeaway: Codex safety posture should combine sandbox boundaries, approval policy, managed network/identity controls, and agent-native telemetry.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Keep v5 x2 runners read-only by default, exact-scope writes only, and generate status receipts that explain why each action happened.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: Codex remains a terminal-first coding agent surface, so local launcher compatibility and version drift matter.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Add command/launcher compatibility checks before long CLI lane starts and keep version/update receipts status-only.

source_rows.source: Model Context Protocol security best practices
source_rows.stable_takeaway: Local tool servers need least privilege, constrained transports, sandboxing, narrow scopes, and elevation loops that avoid broad privilege grants.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Map every app-server, CLI, connector, and MCP helper into baseline-read, elevated-write, or blocked classes.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: Agent skills are execution-layer behavior and need inventory, permission review, isolated testing, monitoring, and approval discipline.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Treat skill evolution as a governed overlay: enabled/disabled labels, provenance, scans, and no plugin-cache or user-skill mutation without exact approval.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: GenAI telemetry now has named conventions for events, exceptions, metrics, model spans, agent spans, MCP, and provider-specific operations.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Shape watcher receipts so later telemetry export can preserve phase, lane, model surface, tool class, error class, and raw-boundary fields.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: Callbacks can observe, customize, and control agent behavior around runtime boundaries.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Model THOS watcher hooks as callback-like gates: pre-launch, post-launch, cadence, completion, quality, repair, and publication.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: Guardrail layers can constrain conversational and agentic behavior before it reaches unsafe action surfaces.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Keep no-overclaim, raw-boundary, credential, path, and canon-gate guards as explicit runner gates instead of prose-only reminders.

source_rows.stable_takeaway: Artifact provenance helps consumers verify where build outputs came from and how they were produced.
source_rows.x2_build_implication: Continue repo-local provenance receipts with subject file hashes, source rows, and remote-equals-local verification.

x2_candidate_builds: Add a watcher telemetry schema draft for lane, phase, boundary, raw-boundary, quality, blocker, and repair fields.
Create a skill overlay registry that labels proposed skills as enabled, disabled, watch-only, or approval-needed without mutating live user skills.
Extend the five-lane board to show repair-state transitions without requiring raw output reads.
Add a source-to-build crosswalk that ties every x2 build artifact to one current-source row and one Journey/Trinity reflection row.
Prepare a command-surface compatibility mini-ledger for CLI launcher, app-server notifier, completion notifier, quality gate, stale-flow, and provenance helpers.
Create a no-overclaim guard row that blocks final physics, consciousness proof, canon promotion, or empirical closure language unless exact evidence exists.
Add an Aster/Arby heading-repair playbook that distinguishes substantial-but-unharvestable output from genuinely shallow output.
Prepare v497 v5 x2 build/run/test/use priorities after the Aster repair check mark.
